# AutocompleteSearchField

A SearchField that offers completions as you type: recent searches when the field is empty, then artists, titles, tags and keys that start with what you typed, chosen with the arrow keys and Enter.

`SongNodes.AutocompleteSearchField` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.AutocompleteSearchField value="…" onChange={…} label="…" suggestions={…} onSelect={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.AutocompleteSearchField" value="…" on-change="{{…}}" label="…" suggestions="{{…}}" on-select="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (AutocompleteSearchFieldProps)

Every SearchFieldProps prop (`value`, `onChange`, `label`, `placeholder`, `resultCount`, `suggestion`, `onSuggestion`, `shortcut`), plus:

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `suggestions` * | `AutocompleteOption[]` | Completions for the current query, best first; at most 8 are shown. |
| `recent` | `string[]` | Recent queries, newest first; shown (at most 5) when the field is empty or they match the query. |
| `onSelect` * | `(value: string, option?: AutocompleteOption) => void` | Called with the chosen option (or the typed text on Enter with no active option). |
| `onClearRecent` | `() => void` | Clears the recent list; shows "Clear recent searches" in the popup foot when given. |
| `suggestionsLabel` | `string` | Group label for suggestions; default "Suggestions" ("Tracks" on the route finder). |

## AutocompleteOption

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `string` | Stable id (unique within the field). |
| `value` * | `string` | Text inserted into the field when chosen ("Bicep"). |
| `label` | `string` | Shown text if it differs from value ("Bicep – Glue"); the typed prefix is marked bold. |
| `meta` | `string` | Right-hand meta in mono ("Artist · 41 tracks", "8A · 124 BPM"). |
